body:
## What it does

The first thing a model generates tends to resemble everything else it has generated. This one reads that output as a senior designer would, calling out placeholder typography and sections that repeat a familiar template, and declines to treat a single pass as finished work. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @inqusit shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
